notes.title: New DLC out now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44091586/27a98ab0aac570d6e9107ac6defebb5ca9294945.png[/img]
We're excited to announce new content for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2402280/Werewolf_The_Apocalypse__The_Book_of_Hungry_Names/]Werewolf: The Apocalypse — The Book of Hungry Names[/url]!  [i]Seek and Destroy[/i] is the latest DLC addition to the sprawling epic.

[i]Seek and Destroy[/i] is on sale, along with the [i]Book of Hungry Names[/i] base game, the [i]Wardens and Furies[/i] DLC and [i]Those Who Refuse to Die[/i] DLC, until April 17th!

[i]Seek and Destroy[/i] unlocks the options to play as a member of the Red Talons tribe and the nomadic Silent Striders tribe.

And, in a special mission, 175,000 words long, hunt down a vampire who feeds off the weak and the helpless. Along the way, you'll uncover his connection to forgotten secrets of the Three Families and the bloodstained legacies they left behind.

Finally, at no additional charge, we've added support for poly relationships in The Book of Hungry Names. You asked for it, and you can now form a throuple with any two of Elton, Nin, Melodie, or Podge. That's six variations in all, all with unique dating and romantic experiences.

The whole game including all DLC now comes to a whopping 2.1 million words! Enjoy!

notes.title: "Those Who Refuse to Die"
notes.notes:
As part of the World of Darkness "Month of Darkness," we're excited to announce new content for [i]Werewolf: The Apocalypse — The Book of Hungry Names[/i]!  [i]Those Who Refuse to Die[/i] is the latest DLC addition to the sprawling epic.

[i]Those Who Refuse to Die[/i] is on sale, along with the [i]Book of Hungry Names[/i] base game, and the [i]Wardens and Furies[/i] DLC until October 17th!

[i]Those Who Refuse to Die[/i] unlocks the options to play as a member of the Galestalkers tribe or the Ghost Council tribe. Experience [i]Werewolf: The Apocalypse — The Book of Hungry Names[/i] as one of the relentless hunters of the Galestalkers or as a member of the secretive and ruthless Ghost Council.

It also unlocks ten entirely new Gifts accessible to other tribes. Steal magic from your enemies with the Crow's Gift. Shatter bonds of all kinds, both physical and mental, with the Hummingbird Prince. Or call down lightning with the Stormcat's Gift.

Finally, at no additional charge, we've added six gorgeous new character portraits to the game, including art for Scarper, Udolpho, Pembe, the drone, and Black Tarn (in both Homid and Lupus form).

Special thanks to Amy Wilkins for creating all of the character portraits in [i]Werewolf: The Apocalypse — The Book of Hungry Names![/i]

notes.title: We've mostly fixed the "reset on upgrade" bug
notes.notes:
Today's build fixes a bug where players could lose significant progress when updating to a new version of the game. The nature of the bug was that the game wasn't "autosaving" at the start of each chapter, but only autosaving once near the very start of the game.

If you're upgrading from the May 6 version to today's version, you'll have no issue upgrading to the latest version. But if you haven't yet upgraded from the Apr 29 version to today's version, you will still lose progress when upgrading to today's version, because the Apr 29 version wasn't autosaving.

If you play through an entire chapter in today's May 8 version of the game, you'll record a valid autosave. Then, future updates will only rewind you to the start of the current chapter, (hopefully only a few minutes of progress lost,) instead of back to the start of the game.

notes.title: Unleash the Beast Within with a New Werewolf: The Apocalypse Bundle!
notes.notes:
Hey Werewolf fans,

Great news for the World of Darkness community! We've just launched an exciting bundle that pairs two great games: our friends' latest release, Werewolf: The Apocalypse — The Book of Hungry Names, with our Werewolf: The Apocalypse — Heart of the Forest.

[b]Bundle Details:[/b]
Enjoy both of these gripping narratives set in the rich, dark story of the Garou for a bundled discount of 10%, now increased to 40% for a limited time until May 10th. Plus, if you already own one of the games, you'll receive an extra discount to complete your set!

[list]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1342620/Werewolf_The_Apocalypse__Heart_of_the_Forest/?snr=1_5_9_]Werewolf: The Apocalypse — Heart of the Forest[/url] takes you on a journey into Europe’s last wilderness where you play as Maia, who arrives at the ancient Białowieża Forest looking to explore her family history.
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2402280/Werewolf_The_Apocalypse__The_Book_of_Hungry_Names/?snr=1_5_9_]Werewolf: The Apocalypse — The Book of Hungry Names[/url] introduces you to a new adventure with hundreds of choices, where you'll face the Wyrm Spirit and uncover lies you might want to believe.
[/list]


Dive deeper into the mysteries of the World of Darkness with this special offer!
